final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM media_averages) SELECT media_averages.media_type_name, media_averages.average_ratio, media_averages.average_ratio - overall_average.average_ratio FROM media_averages JOIN overall_average ON overall_average.average_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE media_averages.average_ratio > overall_average.average_ratio
